title: Hotbar Print
description: Shows the chat messages you get back from certain game commands directly above your item hotbar.
body:
### About
HotbarPrint displays the direct chat feedback you receive from specific game commands right on your hotbar.
### Dependencies
Plugin requires [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)
